chunks.title: OAuth for external analytics apps
chunks.text: # OAuth for external analytics apps

chunks.title: OAuth for external analytics apps
chunks.text:
## Pattern
Front-end acquires a token (auth code + PKCE) for the API's scope; API validates audience and issuer.

chunks.title: OAuth for external analytics apps
chunks.text:
## Steps
1. Register the app in the identity provider; add redirect URI; expose an API scope.
2. Front-end: MSAL or oidc-client with PKCE — never client secrets in the browser.
3. API: validate-signature via JWKS, check `aud` and `iss`, map claims to roles.

chunks.title: OAuth for external analytics apps
chunks.text:
## Common failure
`invalid audience` — the token was minted for a different scope/API. Fix the requested scope, not the API.

chunks.title: AKS NotReady nodes
chunks.text: # AKS NotReady nodes

chunks.title: AKS NotReady nodes
chunks.text:
## Diagnosis
`kubectl describe node <n>` — check conditions and events. Common: disk pressure, kubelet stopped, VM allocation failure during surge.

chunks.title: AKS NotReady nodes
chunks.text:
## Quick remediation
1. Cordon and drain the node, then delete; the cluster autoscaler replaces it.
2. If all nodes NotReady: check control plane status and resource group locks.

chunks.title: AKS NotReady nodes
chunks.text:
## Prevention
Upgrade surge `maxSurge=33%`, pod disruption budgets on critical DaemonSets, and node problem detector alerts into App Insights.

chunks.title: APIM rate limiting
chunks.text: # APIM rate limiting

chunks.title: APIM rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Policies
`rate-limit-by-key` (client key) and `quota-by-key` (long window). Set retry-after in the response via the policy.

chunks.title: APIM rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Design
Return 429 with `Retry-After` seconds; clients must honor it. Pair with a spike-arrest subscription tier.

chunks.title: APIM rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Diagnostics
APIM insights in App Insights: filter `dependencies | where name startswith "apim"`; check `responseCode == 429` ratio per API per product.

chunks.title: KQL basics in App Insights
chunks.text: # KQL basics in App Insights

chunks.title: KQL basics in App Insights
chunks.text:
## Where to query
Logs pane of the App Insights resource (or Azure Monitor / ADX with the same syntax).

chunks.title: KQL basics in App Insights
chunks.text:
## Core tables
`requests` (server calls), `traces` (log lines), `dependencies` (outbound calls), `exceptions`.

chunks.title: KQL basics in App Insights
chunks.text:
## Recipes
- Failed requests: `requests | where success == false | summarize count() by resultCode, name`.
- p95 latency: `requests | summarize p95=percentile(duration, 95) by name`.
- Join errors to traces: `exceptions | join traces on operation_Id`.

chunks.title: KQL basics in App Insights
chunks.text:
## Tip
Every correlated call shares `operation_Id`; start all investigations from it.

chunks.title: Semantic ranker
chunks.text: # Semantic ranker

chunks.title: Semantic ranker
chunks.text:
## What it does
The semantic ranker reranks the top-50 BM25 or vector results using Microsoft's transformer models, improving top-1 relevance.

chunks.title: Semantic ranker
chunks.text:
## How to enable
Set `queryType=semantic`, provide `semanticConfiguration` naming title/content/description priority fields.

chunks.title: Semantic ranker
chunks.text:
## Semantic answers
With `answers=extractive`, the service extracts a short verbatim answer plus highlights. Requires the answer to exist literally in the documents.

chunks.title: Semantic ranker
chunks.text:
## Cost note
Semantic ranker is billed per 1000 queries on Basic+; free tier has a small daily allowance.

chunks.title: Azure AI Search vector index setup
chunks.header: Azure AI Search vector index setup
chunks.text: # Azure AI Search vector index setup

chunks.title: Azure AI Search vector index setup
chunks.text:
## Overview
Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search) supports vector and hybrid retrieval with semantic ranking.

chunks.title: Azure AI Search vector index setup
chunks.text:
## Steps
1. Create the service (Basic tier minimum for semantic ranker).
2. Create an index with a `Edm.Single` collection field `contentVector` with dimensions matching your embedding model (e.g. 768 for text-embedding-004, 1536 for ada-002).
3. Configure a vectorizer and a vector search algorithm (HNSW): `exhaustiveKnn` for small corpora.
4. Push documents with the REST SDK or indexers pulling from Blob Storage.

chunks.title: Azure AI Search vector index setup
chunks.text:
## Hybrid retrieval
Combine `searchText` plus `vectorQueries` and add `queryType=semantic` for reranking.

chunks.title: Azure AI Search vector index setup
chunks.text:
## Quotas
Basic tier: 15 indexes, 2 GB per index. Standard 1: 50 indexes.

chunks.title: Reducing cold start
chunks.text: # Reducing cold start

chunks.title: Reducing cold start
chunks.text:
## Symptoms
First request after idle takes 5-30 seconds.

chunks.title: Reducing cold start
chunks.text:
## Causes
App Service plans scale to zero only on Free/Shared tiers. Functions on Consumption plan unload after idle.

chunks.title: Reducing cold start
chunks.text:
## Mitigations
1. Always Ready: use Premium (EP1-EP3) plan with `minimumElasticInstanceCount = 1`.
2. For Functions: enable `alwaysReady` per function via host.json or set a timer ping every 4 minutes.
3. Keep dependencies lean; lazy-import heavy modules.

chunks.title: Reducing cold start
chunks.text:
## Verification
Measure p95 of the first-request route in App Insights before and after the change.

chunks.title: Deploying a web app to Azure App Service
chunks.header: Deploying a web app to Azure App Service
chunks.text: # Deploying a web app to Azure App Service

chunks.title: Deploying a web app to Azure App Service
chunks.text:
## Overview
App Service is Azure's managed HTTP hosting platform. Deployment supports zip deploy, git push, GitHub Actions and containers.

chunks.title: Deploying a web app to Azure App Service
chunks.text:
## Steps
1. Create the App Service: `az webapp create -n myapp -p myplan -g myrg --runtime "PYTHON:3.12"`.
2. Package the app: `zip -r app.zip . -x .git/*`.
3. Deploy: `az webapp deployment zip-config -n myapp --src app.zip` or use `az webapp up`.

chunks.title: Deploying a web app to Azure App Service
chunks.text:
## Deployment slots
Use staging slots to validate before swap. Slot swap is near-instant and keeps the previous version for instant rollback.

chunks.title: Deploying a web app to Azure App Service
chunks.text:
## Troubleshooting
- **503 after deploy**: the container is still starting; check `az webapp log tail`.
- **App starts but crashes**: check startup command; for Python set `startupFile` or `appCmdLine` in config.

chunks.title: Deploying a web app to Azure App Service
chunks.text:
## Escalation
If deployments consistently fail with 409 conflicts, capture the deployment ID and escalate to the App Service on-call.

chunks.title: Azure DevOps pipelines
chunks.text: # Azure DevOps pipelines

chunks.title: Azure DevOps pipelines
chunks.text:
## Structure
`azure-pipelines.yml`: trigger, pool, stages/jobs/steps. Agents: Microsoft-hosted (free tier limits) or self-hosted.

chunks.title: Azure DevOps pipelines
chunks.text:
## Common tasks
- `UsePythonVersion@0` to pin toolchain.
- `PublishTestResults@2` with pytest junit output.
- `PublishBuildArtifacts@1` for deployable bundles.

chunks.title: Azure DevOps pipelines
chunks.text:
## Practices
Fail fast on lint; cache pip/npm directories by lockfile hash; protect the main branch with a required PR build.

chunks.title: Azure DevOps pipelines
chunks.text:
## Parallelism
Free tier: 1,800 minutes/month, 1 parallel job. Self-hosted agents are unlimited.

chunks.title: Functions timeout and retries
chunks.text: # Functions timeout and retries

chunks.title: Functions timeout and retries
chunks.text:
## Limits
Consumption plan: default 5 min, max 10 min per invocation. Premium/Dedicated: 30 min default, unbounded possible on Dedicated.

chunks.title: Functions timeout and retries
chunks.text:
## Configuration
`functionTimeout` in host.json. For longer work, switch to Durable Functions (chaining) or queue the work.

chunks.title: Functions timeout and retries
chunks.text:
## Retries
Built-in retry (`retry.strategy=fixed|exponential` in function.json) max 5 attempts; for queues, drive retry with the poison-queue pattern (maxDequeueCount = 5).

chunks.title: Functions timeout and retries
chunks.text:
## Idempotency
Make handlers idempotent: retries can duplicate side effects. Use a deterministic key in table storage to deduplicate.

chunks.title: Actionable alerts
chunks.text: # Actionable alerts

chunks.title: Actionable alerts
chunks.text:
## Principles
Alert on symptoms users feel (availability, error rate, latency), not on CPU vanity metrics.

chunks.title: Actionable alerts
chunks.text:
## Setup
1. Availability test (ping + content match) per public endpoint.
2. Metric alert: `requests/failed > 2% for 10 min` via dynamic thresholds.
3. Log alert: `traces | where severity_level == 3` fired per operation_Id.

chunks.title: Actionable alerts
chunks.text:
## Action groups
Page on Sev1 signal only; email the team channel otherwise. Every alert links to a runbook doc; alerts without runbooks are deleted at review time.

chunks.title: VM scale set scale failures
chunks.text: # VM scale set scale failures

chunks.title: VM scale set scale failures
chunks.text:
## Common causes
1. **Quota exceeded**: family vCPU quota reached; request an increase or pick another family.
2. **Allocation failure** (cluster full): try another zone, another SKU, or reduce request.
3. **Image/SKU retired**: check the SKU availability list; pin image versions explicitly.

chunks.title: VM scale set scale failures
chunks.text:
## Commands
`az vmss deallocate` then retry, or update the profile with `--vm-sku`.

chunks.title: VM scale set scale failures
chunks.text:
## Safe rollout
Use rolling upgrade with `--max-batch-instance-percent 20` and health probes wired to a load balancer.

chunks.title: No-answer flow
chunks.text: # No-answer flow

chunks.title: No-answer flow
chunks.text:
## Behavior
When retrieval confidence is low or the model returns the no-answer sentence, the copilot:
1. Shows "I could not find this in the support docs." with zero citations.
2. Surfaces a one-click "Ask an engineer" button that opens a pre-filled ticket.
3. Emits telemetry: `success=true`, `customDimensions.cited=false`, top_doc=null.

chunks.title: No-answer flow
chunks.text:
## Why it matters
The no-answer path is a feature, not a failure: it prevents hallucinated answers and feeds the KB gap list (weekly review of no-answer questions by the KB owner).

chunks.title: Cosmos DB 429 rate limiting
chunks.text: # Cosmos DB 429 rate limiting

chunks.title: Cosmos DB 429 rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Cause
Consumed RU/s exceeded provisioned throughput on a logical partition.

chunks.title: Cosmos DB 429 rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Fixes
1. Read the `x-ms-request-charge` header; log RU per operation.
2. Scale: increase RU/s or switch to autoscale with 10-100% burst.
3. Hot partition: check partition key cardinality; high-frequency keys cause one physical partition to absorb all load.
4. Client: implement the SDK's built-in retry with exponential backoff (default 9 retries).

chunks.title: Cosmos DB 429 rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Sizing heuristic
Plan RU/s >= peak RU/s of the hottest partition * replication factor headroom of 1.25.

chunks.title: Slow Databricks jobs
chunks.text: # Slow Databricks jobs

chunks.title: Slow Databricks jobs
chunks.text:
## Investigate
1. Spark UI: stage skew (max task vs median), spill (memory bytes spilled).
2. Ganglia: CPU/IO saturation on executors.
3. Data delta: has the input grown or the partition count changed?

chunks.title: Slow Databricks jobs
chunks.text:
## Fixes
- Skew: salt the hot key or use AQE skew join (`spark.sql.adaptive.skewJoin.enabled=true`).
- Spill: increase executor memory or repartition before wide transformations.
- Small files: run OPTIMIZE (Delta) before the job window.

chunks.title: Deployment slot swap
chunks.text: # Deployment slot swap

chunks.title: Deployment slot swap
chunks.text:
## Procedure
1. Deploy to the `staging` slot.
2. Warm it: hit the health endpoint on the staging hostname.
3. Swap: `az webapp deployment slot swap -n myapp --slot staging --target-slot production` with `--action swap`.

chunks.title: Deployment slot swap
chunks.text:
## Settings
Mark connection strings as `slot sticky` unless they must swap. App settings swap by default.

chunks.title: Deployment slot swap
chunks.text:
## Rollback
Swap back immediately; the previous bits are preserved on the staging slot.

chunks.title: Deployment slot swap
chunks.text:
## Failure mode
If swap hangs at "sealing", a background process holds a file lock; recycle the target slot after business-impact check.

chunks.title: Diagnosing Entra ID sign-in failures
chunks.text: # Diagnosing Entra ID sign-in failures

chunks.title: Diagnosing Entra ID sign-in failures
chunks.text:
## First checks
1. Sign-in logs: Entra admin center > Monitoring > Sign-in logs. Filter by user and failure status.
2. Read the error code: 50053 (account locked), 50126 (invalid credentials), 50076/50079 (MFA required/challenge failed), 53003 (blocked by Conditional Access).

chunks.title: Diagnosing Entra ID sign-in failures
chunks.text:
## Conditional Access
Check which policy applied: the sign-in log's Conditional Access tab shows granted/failed policies per attempt.

chunks.title: Diagnosing Entra ID sign-in failures
chunks.text:
## Locked accounts
Lockout is usually smart lockout: waits 30-60s. Persistent lockout requires a support ticket with the tenant ID and user object ID.

chunks.title: Diagnosing Entra ID sign-in failures
chunks.text:
## Escalation
If failure code 50158 with external security challenge, escalate to the identity team; do not reset the user's password.

chunks.title: Copilot in daily engineering
chunks.text: # Copilot in daily engineering

chunks.title: Copilot in daily engineering
chunks.text:
## Where it helps
Boilerplate, tests from examples, doc comments, learning an unfamiliar codebase by asking for walkthroughs.

chunks.title: Copilot in daily engineering
chunks.text:
## Where to verify
Security-sensitive code, license compliance, concurrency logic. Copilot suggestions are not reviewed code until a human reviews them.

chunks.title: Copilot in daily engineering
chunks.text:
## Policy
- Never paste customer data or secrets into prompts.
- Prefer workspace-aware Copilot Chat with @workspace for repo-specific answers.
- CI stays the quality gate: Copilot does not bypass tests or reviews.

chunks.title: Key Vault access
chunks.text: # Key Vault access

chunks.title: Key Vault access
chunks.text:
## Two permission models
1. **Access policies** (legacy): vault-level secrets/get grants.
2. **Azure RBAC** (recommended): `Key Vault Secrets User` role at the vault scope.

chunks.title: Key Vault access
chunks.text:
## Common 403 scenarios
- Managed identity missing the role (RBAC mode): error `AccessDenied`.
- Access policy exists but the app uses a different identity than expected.
- Firewall enabled and the app's outbound IPs not allow-listed.

chunks.title: Key Vault access
chunks.text:
## Diagnostics
Use `az keyvault show --query properties.enableRbacAuthorization` first; grant in the same model the vault is in. Mixing modes is the #1 misconfiguration.

chunks.title: Local Kusto (Azure Data Explorer container)
chunks.text: # Local Kusto (Azure Data Explorer container)

chunks.title: Local Kusto (Azure Data Explorer container)
chunks.text:
## Run
`docker run -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -m 2G -p 8080:8080 mcr.microsoft.com/azuredataexplorer/kustainer-linux:latest`
Connect at `http://localhost:8080` with any client (Kusto.Cli, Kusto.Explorer, or the Python `azure-kusto-data` SDK); no auth by default locally.

chunks.title: Local Kusto (Azure Data Explorer container)
chunks.text:
## Ingest files
`.ingest inline into table <| <csv rows>` for small sets; use `.create table` first.

chunks.title: Local Kusto (Azure Data Explorer container)
chunks.text:
## When local vs cloud
Local container for demos/CI; production telemetry goes to a real ADX cluster or App Insights with the same KQL.

chunks.title: Azure OpenAI rate limiting
chunks.text: # Azure OpenAI rate limiting

chunks.title: Azure OpenAI rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Errors
- 429: requests per minute or tokens per minute exceeded.
- `content_filter` result: policy block, not a rate limit.

chunks.title: Azure OpenAI rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Knobs
Per-deployment quota (TPM/RPM) set at creation; can be raised via a support request with the use case.

chunks.title: Azure OpenAI rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Client pattern
Exponential backoff with jitter, honor `retry-after` header; batch prompts where possible; route low-priority traffic to a smaller model deployment.

chunks.title: Azure OpenAI rate limiting
chunks.text:
## Monitoring
Emit a custom metric on each 429 with deployment name; alert at >1% of calls for 10 minutes.

chunks.title: RAG quality playbook
chunks.text: # RAG quality playbook

chunks.title: RAG quality playbook
chunks.text:
## Levers, in order of impact
1. **Chunking**: header-aware 800-1200 char chunks with 100-150 overlap; keep procedures whole.
2. **Retrieval k**: start at 4; measure hit@k on a golden set before tuning.
3. **Prompt**: answer only from context; require [n] citations; explicit no-answer fallback sentence.
4. **Reranking**: cross-encoder rerank of top-20 to top-4 helps at moderate latency cost.

chunks.title: RAG quality playbook
chunks.text:
## Measurement
Golden set of >= 15 real questions; track hit@3, citation rate, no-answer correctness. Regressions block release.

chunks.title: Golden-set evaluation
chunks.text: # Golden-set evaluation

chunks.title: Golden-set evaluation
chunks.text:
## What runs
`pytest -m eval` (network required). For each golden question:
1. Embed and retrieve top-3; hit if the expected doc is among them.
2. Generate the answer; citation rate counts answers containing [n] markers.
3. Record latency.

chunks.title: Golden-set evaluation
chunks.text:
## Targets (v1)
- Retrieval hit@3 >= 0.8
- Citation rate >= 0.9
- p95 latency < 6000 ms

chunks.title: Golden-set evaluation
chunks.text:
## Adding questions
Append to eval/golden.json with the expected doc id; questions must come from real user asks, not invented ones, to avoid overfitting.

chunks.title: Responsible AI checklist
chunks.text: # Responsible AI checklist

chunks.title: Responsible AI checklist
chunks.text:
## Before launch
1. **Grounding**: answers restricted to retrieved context; no free-form hallucination path.
2. **Citations**: every answer links its sources; a no-answer fallback exists.
3. **Human oversight**: users can report a wrong answer in one click; reports feed the eval set.
4. **Privacy**: prompts/logs scrubbed of customer identifiers; retention <= 30 days by default.
5. **Bias/fairness**: eval set covers diverse phrasings; measure answer quality across them.
6. **Transparency**: UI states that answers are AI-generated.

chunks.title: Responsible AI checklist
chunks.text:
## At review time
Attach eval run results (hit rate, citation rate) to the release PR.

chunks.title: Azure SQL deadlocks
chunks.text: # Azure SQL deadlocks

chunks.title: Azure SQL deadlocks
chunks.text:
## Diagnosis
Query Store + `sys.dm_xe_database_sessions` deadlock events, or enable deadlock XML capture to blob.

chunks.title: Azure SQL deadlocks
chunks.text:
## Common patterns
- Opposite-order updates in two transactions: rewrite both to touch tables in the same order.
- Long transactions holding locks: keep transactions short; avoid user interaction inside one.

chunks.title: Azure SQL deadlocks
chunks.text:
## Mitigations
Retry logic on deadlock victim (error 1205) with jitter; snapshot isolation (RCSI) for read-heavy workloads (ON by default in Azure SQL).

chunks.title: Storage 403 AuthorizationPermissionMismatch
chunks.text: # Storage 403 AuthorizationPermissionMismatch

chunks.title: Storage 403 AuthorizationPermissionMismatch
chunks.text:
## Cause
The request reached the service authenticated, but the identity lacks the data-plane RBAC role (e.g. missing `Storage Blob Data Reader`).

chunks.title: Storage 403 AuthorizationPermissionMismatch
chunks.text:
## Fix
1. Assign the data-plane role: `az role assignment create --assignee <objectId> --role "Storage Blob Data Reader" --scope <container-resource-id>`.
2. Wait up to 5 minutes for propagation.
3. Distinguish from 401 (AuthenticationFailed): 401 is key/token invalid, 403 is permission.

chunks.title: Storage 403 AuthorizationPermissionMismatch
chunks.text:
## Network rule interplay
If the account has `defaultAction = Deny`, also grant the client subnet or use service endpoints; symptom is 403 `IpAddressRangeRestriction`.

chunks.title: Escalation policy
chunks.text: # Escalation policy

chunks.title: Escalation policy
chunks.text:
## Severity levels
- **Sev1**: production down or data loss. 15-min response SLA, page on-call immediately.
- **Sev2**: major feature degraded with no workaround. 1-hour response.
- **Sev3**: minor feature issue, workaround exists. 1 business day.
- **Sev4**: question / how-to. 2 business days.

chunks.title: Escalation policy
chunks.text:
## Path
L1 support -> service on-call (via the Support Copilot's 'not found' flow, create the ticket with the required fields) -> service owner for Sev1 within 30 minutes.

chunks.title: Escalation policy
chunks.text:
## Required fields when escalating
Tenant/customer ID, operation_Id from telemetry, reproduction steps, business impact statement.

chunks.title: Teams app permissions
chunks.text: # Teams app permissions

chunks.title: Teams app permissions
chunks.text:
## Delegated vs application
Delegated scopes act as the signed-in user; application permissions act as the app alone and need admin consent.

chunks.title: Teams app permissions
chunks.text:
## Minimum-scope rule
Request only the scopes used; `Sites.Read.All` beats `Sites.FullControl.All` for reading.

chunks.title: Teams app permissions
chunks.text:
## Consent errors
`AADSTS65001` — user/admin has not granted consent: admin consent link must be used for application permissions. `invalid_grant` usually means expired secret or redirect URI mismatch.

chunks.title: Ticket triage
chunks.text: # Ticket triage

chunks.title: Ticket triage
chunks.text:
## Steps
1. Classify severity per the escalation policy (see support-escalation-policy).
2. Extract identifiers early: tenant ID, subscription, request/correlation ID, operation_Id.
3. Search the knowledge base; if an article answers it, link the article and resolve.
4. If two engineers see the same issue within 60 minutes, raise severity one level and inform the service owner.

chunks.title: Ticket triage
chunks.text:
## Quality bar
Every resolved ticket records: root cause, fix or workaround, and the doc that helped (or 'no doc' — which feeds back into KB gaps).

chunks.title: VNet peering DNS
chunks.text: # VNet peering DNS

chunks.title: VNet peering DNS
chunks.text:
## Symptom
Peered VNets route fine (ping works by IP) but names don't resolve.

chunks.title: VNet peering DNS
chunks.text:
## Cause
Private DNS zones aren't linked to both VNets, or the VM uses the default Azure DNS with no custom resolution path.

chunks.title: VNet peering DNS
chunks.text:
## Fix
1. Create a private DNS zone per service (privatelink.database.azure.com etc).
2. Link the zone to BOTH VNets (`az network private-dns link vnet create`).
3. For hub-spoke with custom DNS servers, set spoke VNet DNS servers to the hub resolvers and re-DHCP the VMs.

chunks.title: VNet peering DNS
chunks.text:
## Validation
`nslookup <hostname>` should return a private 10.x address, not the public IP.
